kpis.description: % of closed audit reviews where SLA was NOT breached per auditor (uses invert:true since bool field captures breaches)

kpis.name: Credit Approval Rate
kpis.description: % of credit applications approved (vs declined). Higher reflects healthier portfolio acceptance.

kpis.name: Credit Decline Rate
kpis.description: % of credit applications declined — quality filter. Too low signals weak underwriting; too high signals weak origination.

kpis.name: Credit Rework Rate
kpis.description: % of credit applications requiring rework (missing docs, incomplete analysis). Lower is better.

kpis.name: Credit TAT - Standard
kpis.description: Turnaround time in days for standard credit applications from submission to decision. Lower is better. Target: ≤7 days.

kpis.name: Credit TAT - Complex
kpis.description: Turnaround time in days for complex credit applications (corporate, structured). Target: ≤21 days.

kpis.name: Credit TAT - Express
kpis.description: Turnaround time in days for express/personal loans. Target: ≤24hrs (1 day).

kpis.name: Loan Disbursement TAT
kpis.description: Days from credit approval to actual disbursement. Reflects credit admin / perfection efficiency.

kpis.name: Credit Initiative Status
kpis.description: Status score (1-5) of strategic credit initiatives — process improvement, portfolio diversification.

kpis.name: Credit Initiative Count
kpis.description: Number of credit-improvement initiatives delivered per quarter.

kpis.name: Compliance Score
kpis.description: Compliance assessment score (1-5) — adherence to internal credit policy and CBK Prudential Guidelines.

kpis.name: Due Diligence Quality
kpis.description: Due diligence quality score (1-5) on credit assessment thoroughness.

kpis.name: NPL Ratio
kpis.description: Non-Performing Loans Ratio — gross NPLs ÷ gross loans (lower is better)

kpis.name: Product Book Achievement
kpis.description: Product category actual book vs target book — sum of actual_book / sum of target_book across products in category

kpis.name: Product Revenue Achievement
kpis.description: Product category actual revenue vs target revenue — same aggregation as book

kpis.name: Product NPL Rate
kpis.description: Product category weighted-avg NPL rate — book-weighted across products in category. CBK PG/04 aligned.

kpis.name: Product Growth Rate
kpis.description: Product category book growth quarter-over-quarter — book-weighted avg

kpis.name: Liquidity Coverage Ratio
kpis.description: BCBS d295 LCR — HQLA / 30-day net cash outflows. Regulatory minimum 100%. Treasury-owned.

kpis.name: Net Stable Funding Ratio
kpis.description: BCBS d295 NSFR — Available stable funding / required stable funding. Regulatory minimum 100%.

kpis.name: Net Interest Margin
kpis.description: Net interest income / average earning assets. Core Treasury profitability driver.

kpis.name: FX Trading Income
kpis.description: Foreign exchange trading revenue — dealer P&L plus corporate FX spread. Treasury-owned.

kpis.name: Trade Finance Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue from trade finance instruments (LC, guarantees, collections, supplier finance). Replaces K022.

kpis.name: Trade Document Check TAT
kpis.description: Average hours from document receipt to discrepancy decision. ICC UCP 600 §14 mandates within 5 banking days; operational target far tighter.

kpis.name: Letters of Credit — Volume
kpis.description: Number of LCs issued in the period. Volume proxy for trade finance market share.

kpis.name: Campaign ROI
kpis.description: Marketing-attributable revenue / campaign spend, expressed as %. Marketing-owned.

kpis.name: Brand Awareness
kpis.description: Unaided brand recall in target segment, survey-based.

kpis.name: Marketing-Qualified Leads
kpis.description: Leads passed to sales pipeline meeting MQL criteria. Feeds pipeline_to_bsc downstream.

kpis.name: Marketing-Driven Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue attributable to marketing-sourced leads (UTM + first-touch attribution).

kpis.name: Account Opening TAT
kpis.description: Median hours from KYC submission to account live. CSO-owned operational quality metric.

kpis.name: Complaint Resolution Rate
kpis.description: % of customer complaints resolved within SLA. Replaces K008.

kpis.name: Pipeline Deals Won
kpis.description: Count of pipeline deals reaching won stages (Disbursed / Closed Won / Signed / Documentation) per quarter. Sourced from pipeline_activity_bridge.

kpis.name: Pipeline Conversion Rate
kpis.description: Won / (won + lost + active) × 100. Sales effectiveness. Replaces K020.

kpis.name: New Customers Acquired
kpis.description: Distinct customers from won pipeline deals per quarter. Sourced from pipeline_activity_bridge OR estimated by branch_staff_generator for staff not active in pipeline.

kpis.name: Cost-to-Income Ratio
kpis.description: Cost-to-Income Ratio = Total Operating Costs / Total Operating Income × 100. Tier-1 benchmark; lower is better. Tracks whether income growth outpaces cost growth. Computed by utils/financial_ratios_engine.py (v10.390). Awaiting MD target.

kpis.name: Return on Equity
kpis.description: Return on Equity = Net Income / Average Shareholders' Equity × 100. NOTE: v10.390 engine uses PBT (not net income) since mgmt_accounts has no tax field. Engine reports the caveat in result.note. Awaiting tax field addition + MD target.
kpis._caveat: Engine uses PBT until tax field added to mgmt_accounts

kpis.name: Total Deposit Growth
kpis.description: Total Deposit Growth = (Deposits EoP - Deposits BoP) / Deposits BoP × 100. Bank-wide deposit growth aggregating Retail+Commercial. Computed by utils/financial_ratios_engine.py (v10.390). Awaiting MD target.

kpis.deprecation_note: Marked deprecated in v10.473 KPI rationalisation — no role currently references this KPI. Retained for historical data integrity (existing BSC entries against this KPI continue to work). To reactivate: add to role_kpis[role] and remove 'deprecated' field.

kpis.name: Asset Referral
kpis.description: Value of asset (lending) deals the staff referred that materialized. Shadow / recognition only — credited to the referrer; does NOT feed consolidated P&L.

kpis.name: Liabilities/Deposit Referral
kpis.description: Value of liability (deposit) deals the staff referred that materialized. Shadow / recognition only — credited to the referrer; does NOT feed consolidated P&L.

kpis.name: Credit TAT (SLA clock, days)
kpis.description: Mean business-day credit turnaround per staff, derived from the pipeline SLA clocks (credit_assessment -> disbursement/security_perfection on deal.sla_step_log). Shadow / validation only — weight 0, does not affect appraisal scores. Source for the eventual promotion of K011 / the credit lane TATs.

kpis.name: Loan-to-Deposit Ratio
kpis.description: Net loans as a percentage of deposits.

kpis.name: Customer Active Rate
kpis.description: Share of customers transacting in the period.

kpis.name: Active Customers on Digital Platforms
kpis.description: Active customers using card, mobile or online channels.

kpis.name: Customer Satisfaction Score (CSAT)
kpis.description: Customer satisfaction survey score.

kpis.name: Cross-Sell Ratio
kpis.description: Average number of products held per customer.

kpis.name: New-to-Bank Customers
kpis.description: Net new customers onboarded in the period.

kpis.name: Dormancy Ratio
kpis.description: Share of accounts dormant.

kpis.name: Regrettable Staff Turnover
kpis.description: Voluntary exits of staff the bank wished to retain.

kpis.name: Total Staff Turnover
kpis.description: All staff exits as a share of headcount.

kpis.name: Succession Coverage — Critical Roles
kpis.description: Critical and leadership roles with at least one identified successor.

kpis.name: Employee Engagement Score
kpis.description: Engagement survey score.

kpis.name: Revenue per Staff
kpis.description: Total revenue divided by headcount.

kpis.name: Mandatory Training Completion
kpis.description: Group-assigned mandatory training completed before deadline.

kpis.name: Personal Development Plans in Place
kpis.description: Staff with a documented development plan.

kpis.name: Critical Skills Coverage
kpis.description: Coverage of critical skills in priority areas.

kpis.name: Performance Management Cycle Adherence
kpis.description: Goal setting, half-year review and year-end appraisal completed on time.

kpis.name: Leave Utilisation & Block Leave
kpis.description: Mandatory block leave taken and annual leave utilised.

kpis.name: ARR Audit Rating
kpis.description: Annual Risk Review rating — minimum Room For Improvement.

kpis.name: FCR Issue Assurance Rating
kpis.description: Financial Crime Review issue-assurance outcome — minimum Pass.

kpis.name: RCSA Quality Assurance
kpis.description: Satisfaction rating on RCSA quality assurance.

kpis.name: On-Time Issue Remediation (OTR)
kpis.description: Audit and regulatory issues remediated within agreed timelines.

kpis.name: Overdue Audit Issues
kpis.description: Issues past their remediation date at month end.

kpis.name: Operational Loss as % of PBT
kpis.description: Operational risk losses as a share of budgeted PBT.

kpis.name: Regulatory Fines as % of PBT
kpis.description: Losses from regulatory fines as a share of PBT.

kpis.name: eCAP Issues Closed On Time
kpis.description: Outstanding eCAP items closed with no overdue items at month end.

kpis.name: Expired CAs / Deferrals / Ticklers
kpis.description: Expired credit approvals, TODs, deferrals, call memos or insurance ticklers.

kpis.name: LCY:FCY Balance Sheet Split
kpis.description: Local-currency share of the balance sheet.

kpis.name: AU Deposit Concentration
kpis.description: AU deposits as a percentage of total FCY balance sheet.

kpis.name: CCB Contribution to Total Revenue
kpis.description: Consumer & Commercial Banking share of total revenue.

kpis.name: Loss-Making Branches Turned Around
kpis.description: Share of loss-making branches returned to profit.

kpis.name: Deposit Mobilisation (Sales as a Service)
kpis.description: New deposits mobilised by non-sales functions.

kpis.name: Account Referrals
kpis.description: Customer account referrals introduced.

kpis.name: Distribution Strategy Implementation
kpis.description: Completion of the distribution strategy action plan.

kpis.name: Value Chain Alignment
kpis.description: Value chains identified and activated with CCB.

kpis.name: Fintech Partners Onboarded
kpis.description: New fintech partnerships signed.

kpis.name: Digital Sales Onboarding & Activation
kpis.description: Digital onboarding rate and subsequent active usage.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total affiliate revenue.

kpis.name: Total Operating Expenses
kpis.description: Total operating expenses.

kpis.name: Net Loans
kpis.description: Net loans and advances outstanding.

kpis.name: Total Deposits
kpis.description: Total customer deposits.

kpis.name: Critical Vacancies Filled
kpis.description: Critical vacant roles, including Branch Managers, filled to plan.

kpis.name: Graduate Programme Implementation
kpis.description: Graduate programme run and cohort onboarded.

kpis.name: Regulatory Relationship Management
kpis.description: Proactive engagement with and participation before the regulator.

kpis.name: Group Budget & Financial Audit Closure
kpis.description: Group budget and financial audit process closed within Group timelines.
